Privacy

Privacy, in plain language.

This notice describes the behavior of the supplied website build. Hosting and any services added later may introduce additional processing.

Browser tools

The included calculators and text tools process entries in your browser. The tool code does not send those entries to a server. Avoid entering sensitive information on a shared device.

Hosting and technical information

The hosting provider may process request information such as IP addresses, requested URLs and browser information to deliver and secure the website. Consult the hosting provider’s applicable privacy information for details.

External links and images

YouTube, Facebook, purchase links and resource download links take you to external services with their own policies. Video thumbnail images, when you publish video entries, may be loaded from YouTube’s image service, which receives a browser request.

Cookies and analytics

This supplied build does not include advertising, analytics scripts or tracking cookies. The optional local content editor stores drafts in the browser on the device where it is used. Update this notice before adding analytics, advertising, forms, payments or other data collection.

Contact

Use the channels on the contact page for questions about this website. Do not send sensitive information in public comments.
